findings.source_passage: is much more handsome and becoming to the boat, than hemp. Hemp is a dusky, dark fellow, a sort of Indian; but Manilla is as a golden-haired Circassian to behold.
findings.why_it_matters: The personification 'Hemp is a dusky, dark fellow, a sort of Indian' is a voice-establishing comic aside; the draft reduces it to a bare contrast, losing the mock-characterization and the 'to behold' flourish.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'Hemp is a dusky, dark fellow, a sort of Indian; but Manilla is as a golden-haired Circassian to behold.' verbatim or near-verbatim.

findings.source_passage: like being seated in the midst of the manifold whizzings of a steam-engine in full play, when every flying beam, and shaft, and wheel, is grazing you. It is worse;
findings.source_locator: paragraph on whaling disasters, steam-engine simile
findings.why_it_matters: The source adds 'It is worse' as a rhetorical intensifier after the steam-engine comparison, and specifies 'every flying beam, and shaft, and wheel'—the draft omits both, softening the mounting terror the passage constructs.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'when every flying beam, and shaft, and wheel, is grazing you. It is worse;' to preserve the escalating rhetorical structure.

findings.source_passage: as the profound calm which only apparently precedes and prophesies of the storm, is perhaps more awful than the storm itself; for, indeed, the calm is but the wrapper and envelope
findings.why_it_matters: The draft inverts the syntax ('More awful than the storm is the profound calm'), losing Melville's build-up and the word 'prophesies,' which carries interpretive weight about the line as omen. The original periodic structure is signature.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the original order: 'the profound calm which only apparently precedes and prophesies of the storm, is perhaps more awful than the storm itself' to preserve the rhetorical accumulation.

summary: The draft preserves all high-priority signatures—including the key closing passage, the 'ringed lightnings' / 'shaken jelly' / 'halters round every neck' sequence, and the final philosophical peroration—with only minor voice-flattening in three subordinate passages, none rising to high severity.
